get.summary: Downloads logs of remote agents.

parameters.name: agentIdentifier
parameters.description: Used in order to filter logs by Agent

parameters.name: hoursBack
parameters.description: Used to retrieve logs within the specified timeframe

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description:
Optional. A filter that chooses which log entries to return.
See SOAR Documentation (https://cloud.google.com/chronicle/docs/soar/admin-tasks/advanced/retrieve-raw-python-logs).
Only log entries that match the filter are returned.
An empty filter matches all log entries.
Maximum filter length is 10000 characters.
The filter supports the following properties for siemplify components:
    labels.integration_name
    labels.integration_instance
    labels.integration_version
    labels.connector_name
    labels.connector_instance
    labels.action_name
    labels.job_name
    labels.correlation_id

parameters.name: PageToken
parameters.description:
Optional. Used in order to paginate through all the results. The token that should be used to retrieve the next page is
returned from the previous request. A value of an empty string retrieves the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The size of page to request. The response will not be larger than this, but may be smaller.
A value of null or 0 uses a server-defined page size of 1000. Max value is 10000.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
Optional. How the results should be sorted. Presently, the only permitted values are "asc" (default) and "desc".
The first option returns entries in order of increasing values of LogEntry.timestamp (oldest first),
and the second option returns entries in order of decreasing timestamps (newest first).
Entries with equal timestamps are returned in order of their insert_id values.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: Set internal. Logging bucket resource to fetch logs from.

parameters.name: Pod
parameters.description: Set internal. Kubernetes pod to fetch logs from, used as part of the filter.
